changes.text: The "(off)" tag on a disabled shortcut row uses `margin-inline-start` instead of `margin-left`, so its gap sits on the correct side under `dir="rtl"`.
Rows render their `Kbd` key caps with `hideOnMobile={false}`, so the overlay keeps showing its bindings on touch devices where `Kbd` now hides itself by default.

New component: the GitHub/Slack-style "?" keyboard shortcuts overlay, built on `Modal` and always in sync with the live `shortcuts` registry, with a section per `group`, `Kbd` key caps showing the effective (remapped) combos, disabled rows struck through with a visible "(off)", and a `groupOrder` prop. It registers its own hotkey through the registry (`hotkey`, default `'?, mod+/'`, id `ss:shortcuts-help`; `null` registers nothing), so it can itself be disabled and remapped.

`editable` prop turns the overlay into a built-in WCAG 2.1.4 settings UI: a per-row enable `Switch`, a Change button that records the next keydown as the new binding (reserved browser combos are rejected, Escape cancels), a per-row Reset, the global single-key switch (`characterKeys`) and Restore defaults, all announced through a live region.
